label: GO step: choosing a1 after a rewarded trial, early/mid episode (decays with streak and episode time)
explanation: Fires only at GO (100% of mass), and almost only when the agent is about to choose a1 (strong a1 policy logit; choice>8 covers 99.6% of mass) after the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward=1 holds 99% of mass). It never fires on D1/D2, on a2 choices, or after unrewarded trials. The only FUTURE variable is action, which is the agent own upcoming choice and is legitimate; the observed-only form (phase==GO)&(prev_action==1)&(prev_reward==1) is weaker (F1 0.57, mass 0.76) because it misses rewarded trials after an a2 or rare transition that still lead to choosing a1. Magnitude is largest on the first rewarded a1 trial after a break and decays step by step over consecutive rewarded a1 trials (e.g. 1.00, 0.94, 0.83, 0.75, 0.67). It also falls with episode time and is silent after trial ~85, which is why ep_trial<80 raises precision. The decaying magnitude is what limits precision: late in long streaks the conditions hold but the unit stays below threshold. Firing is more common when S1 is the good state and in episodes that start with S1 good. An alternative, (phase==GO)&(choice>8.07)&(ep_trial<75), gets dev F1 0.75.
